messages:
Nia Patel: FYI incoming candidate Arjun Mehta is flying from Bangalore for an onsite on 2026-07-20. He requested a visa invitation letter for his business visa, campus parking permit, and a rental car pickup at the airport. Can we coordinate?

Omar Li: I can handle the rental car and parking permit. Do we cover rental? What's the per diem / policy?

Nia Patel: We cover rental up to $100/day for up to 3 days if public transit is infeasible. Add note in invite. Also need the visa invite letter ASAP so he can book the visa appointment.

Facilities: For campus parking, preferred lot is Lot C visitor permits. We can reserve a temporary monthly pass and leave it at reception. Need license plate or will we give a hangtag?

Nia Patel: He'll rent a car, so ask for license plate on arrival. I'll ask Arjun to share the plate once he has the rental confirmation. For the visa letter I need the exact dates and the role/title to include.

Omar Li: Rental car pickup at 2026-07-19 22:30 local. He lands late. Will arrange key drop at the airport counter. I'll DM confirmation when booked.

Nia Patel: Role: Senior Software Engineer (Interview Loop: Eng Backend). Interview date: 2026-07-20 (onsite). Travel: 2026-07-19 - 2026-07-22. Please generate the letter and attach to the calendar invite.

IT Ops: For the onsite tech setup, does he need a loaner? Remote dev env or pairing?

Nia Patel: He prefers to use his own laptop but will need guest Wi-Fi cert and an ethernet port for the system design session. Also add low-friction VPN for the pairing pod.

IT Ops: Noted. We'll pre-provision guest cert and a temporary VPN token for that day. Also ensure ethernet tested in meeting room C2.

Nia Patel: Visa letter draft command (for records):
```/visa-letter generate --name "Arjun Mehta" --nationality "India" --role "Senior Software Engineer" --dates "2026-07-19 to 2026-07-22" --purpose "onsite interviews and technical assessment"```

PeopleOps Bot: Visa letter request submitted: VISA-20260719-33. Draft available at /docs/visalett/VISA-20260719-33.pdf.

Finance: Quick note on expenses 5 rental cap $100/day and ride reimbursements up to $80 one-way. Send candidate the expense pre-approval form before travel.

Omar Li: Rental booked with Hertz. Confirmation: HZH-55921. Plate will be provided when he picks up. I've set pickup for the airport counter and arranged for after-hours key drop.

Nia Patel: Can someone volunteer to greet him at reception? He arrives late night but will check into hotel. Need greeting 9:15am on 7/20 to escort to building.

Facilities: I can do the greeter at 9:15 and will have the Lot C hangtag at reception. We'll also post a sign.

Nia Patel: Accessibility note: candidate asked for a lower-lit meeting room for migraine sensitivity. Please reserve Room C2 with dimmable lights.

IT Ops: C2 confirmed with wired ethernet and monitor. VPN token created and sent to Arjun via secure link on 7/20 morning.

PeopleOps Bot: Parking permit prepared: PERMIT-VC-772. Loaner/guest Wi-Fi cert request logged: WIFI-20260720-11. Reminder scheduled: send visa letter + expense form + itinerary 5 days before travel.

Omar Li: I'll DM Arjun the rental confirmation and ask for license plate when available.

Nia Patel: Great. Last item 5 add note to calendar: "Bring passport for reception; parking hangtag held at reception; show rental confirmation for plate." I'll send the candidate-facing email after the visa letter is finalized.

PeopleOps Bot: Candidate email template queued: send when VISA-20260719-33 is finalized. :::end of thread:::
